# Isaura / Hermes / Claw — AI Orchestration System

> Procurement copilot building in alpha phase. Multi-agent system with DeepSeek, Claude Opus, GPT-5, and local execution.

## Core files (read in order)

- [CONTEXT_INDEX.md](CONTEXT_INDEX.md) — Navigation map. Read first. ~350 tokens.
- [PROMPT_ENTRY.md](PROMPT_ENTRY.md) — Progressive context loading with token budgets. ~250 tokens.
- [ALPHA-VALIDATION.md](ALPHA-VALIDATION.md) — Stack validation protocol for alpha launch. ~950 tokens.
- [PREMIUMUI-ACCESS.md](PREMIUMUI-ACCESS.md) — Access modes per LLM role. ~250 tokens.

## Agent instructions

- [HERMES_README.md](HERMES_README.md) — Chairman/nightly goal generator. ~500 tokens.
- [CLAW_README.md](CLAW_README.md) — Execution CTO (OpenClaw gateway). ~350 tokens.
- [BROWSER_LLM_PACKET.md](BROWSER_LLM_PACKET.md) — Copy-paste session init for browser LLMs. ~250 tokens.
- [MARCELA_RUNBOOK.md](MARCELA_RUNBOOK.md) — PT-BR step-by-step for human relay. ~250 tokens.
- [CLOUD_POLICY.md](CLOUD_POLICY.md) — Security policy for what goes in this repo. ~250 tokens.

## Architecture

- [architecture/SPREAD_ARCHITECTURE.md](architecture/SPREAD_ARCHITECTURE.md) — Multi-model parallel orchestration. ~450 tokens.
- [architecture/ROUTING_RULES.md](architecture/ROUTING_RULES.md) — Model routing and cost governance. ~250 tokens.
- [architecture/ACCOUNTABILITY_GOVERNOR.md](architecture/ACCOUNTABILITY_GOVERNOR.md) — Anti-escapism and enforcement. ~350 tokens.
- [architecture/ISAURA_SYSTEM_STATE.md](architecture/ISAURA_SYSTEM_STATE.md) — Current system state and active services. ~250 tokens.

## Tokenomics

- [tokenomics/INDEX.md](tokenomics/INDEX.md) — Central registry: budgets, costs, allocation rules. ~100 tokens.
- [tokenomics/CURRENT.json](tokenomics/CURRENT.json) — Live allocation per agent/model. ~150 tokens.
- [tokenomics/history/](tokenomics/history/) — Archived snapshots when budget changes.

## Runbooks

- [runbooks/RUNBOOK_browser_spread.md](runbooks/RUNBOOK_browser_spread.md) — Browser relay procedure for multi-model spreads. ~350 tokens.

## Archive (compressed)

- [archive/](archive/) — Older context files compressed into summary form. Check `archive/ARCHIVE_INDEX.md`.

## Scripts

- `scripts/sanitize_context.py` — Sanitizes local files for repo upload.
- `scripts/check_context_integrity.py` — Refreshes integrity manifest.
- `scripts/scan_context.sh` — Scans for sensitive data leaks.
- `scripts/compress_context.py` — Compresses old context into summaries.
- `scripts/sync_to_context.sh` — Syncs to GitHub.

## Agent Workspace (LLM-to-LLM layer)

- [AGENT_WORKSPACE.md](AGENT_WORKSPACE.md) — Conventions for any LLM to read/write structured data here. ~300 tokens.

## Reviews

- [reviews/isaura-pre-alpha-v1.json](reviews/isaura-pre-alpha-v1.json) — Pre-alpha critique & suggestions (v1). LLM-agnostic, versioned.

*Total repo: ~3,400 lines / ~500KB. Entire context fits in most LLM windows.*
